name: NOW World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Changed hands when a challenger ended the champion's own undefeated streak with a top-rope leg drop, both men left unconscious.

name: NOW Midwest Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Changed hands in an upset tiger suplex, the challenger avenging a loss to the same champion two months earlier.

name: NOW Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Defended in a brutal outside brawl settled by countout after a chair shot and a concrete powerbomb.
